title: Luotain2 IV-003 paired fixed-R and matched-power structural identifiability
status: both CI jobs passed; new frozen synthetic seeds; unmodified original Discoverer

design.search_family: linear time-delayed shifted fields; FFT residual proposals plus explicitly supplied local-neighbor stencil groups
design.selection: noise-corrected validation error plus fixed complexity penalty
design.estimator_comparison: IV/OLS use identical observed simulation, same regressor time indices and same candidate selection algorithm; fitted residuals can cause subsequent candidate sequences to diverge

interpretation: Both procedures depend on process excitation. At a fixed total latent field SD and fixed absolute sensor SD, disjoint-time IV recovers exact support at lower excitation than matched-row OLS on the two chosen synthetic families. No unique general threshold or causal theorem is proved.
limits: Only two known synthetic model families, 3 seeds each
Local-stencil proposals are explicitly given; not general open-grammar discovery
Strict spatially i.i.d. additive Gaussian sensor noise, calibrated from benchmark settings
Equal global variance does not equalize spectral rank, modal distribution, time-dependent variance, or instrument strength
The tested sensor noise SD is 4% of latent field SD, not the original 1% relative-noise setting
Process-noise ratio is simulator-specific and not physiologically calibrated
All candidate support evaluations and fitting remain synthetic, no real EEG anatomical coupling established
IV and OLS follow potentially different proposal histories after their first fitted residual
Estimation of noise variance from observations was not tested
